bodyHtml:
🔐 Password & 2FA Specialists · Gold Coast & Surrounds

Password Manager & 2FA Setup Gold Coast. One Strong Password For Everything.

Sick of losing your passwords all the time and having to reset them? There are good password managers, and there are bad ones. We install and configure the best password manager for you on your computer and devices, so you have one password for everything, plus two-factor authentication set up properly on the accounts that matter most.

Secure My Passwords
✓ Cross-Device Setup
✓ 2FA Configuration
✓ One-On-One Training
✓ Onsite Or Remote
Why It Matters

Reusing Passwords Puts Every Account At Risk.

The moment one website you use gets breached, any other account sharing that same password is exposed too. Sticky notes, a notebook by the desk, or letting the browser quietly remember everything aren't secure, and they don't travel with you across devices.

Our Approach

Set Up Once, Sorted For Good.

We assess what accounts matter most to you, set up a genuinely reputable password manager, migrate your existing logins into it, generate strong unique passwords where you need them, and configure two-factor authentication on the accounts worth protecting properly, like email, banking and socials.

What's Included

What's Included In Our Password Manager & 2FA Service.

🔑

Password Manager Installation

Set up and configured on your computer, phone and tablet, so it's there whenever you need it.

📥

Secure Vault Migration

Your existing logins moved across from browsers, notes apps or wherever they're currently scattered.

📲

Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) Setup

Authenticator apps or hardware keys configured on your most important accounts, for an extra layer of protection beyond just a password.

🔄

Cross-Device Sync

The same secure vault available on your computer, phone and tablet, no more re-typing passwords on every device.

🩺

Password Health Check

We flag reused, weak or old passwords so you know exactly what needs updating first.

🎓

One-On-One Training

A proper walkthrough so you're confident using it day-to-day, not just left with an app you don't understand.

Common Signs You Need This

Sound Familiar?

  • Same password everywhere, one breach anywhere means every account is at risk.
  • Constant resets, you're clicking "forgot password" more often than actually logging in.
  • Passwords written down, a notebook, sticky notes, or a text file full of logins.
  • No 2FA on the accounts that matter, email, banking and social accounts left with just a password.
  • Not sure what's already been breached, you don't know which of your old passwords may already be compromised.
Secure My Passwords
Related Services

Lock The Rest Of Your Digital Life Down Too.

  • Already lost access to an account? Our account recovery service can help you get back in first.
  • Want the whole PC locked down? See our computer & network security service.
  • Email keeps giving you grief? We handle email setup & problems too.
  • Suspect something's already on your PC? Get virus & spyware removal sorted alongside your password cleanup.
Frequently Asked Questions

Password Manager & 2FA Questions, Answered.

What exactly is a password manager, and why do I need one?

It's a secure vault that stores and auto-fills your passwords, so you only need to remember one master password instead of dozens of different ones. It also makes it practical to use a genuinely strong, unique password for every account.

Isn't my browser's "remember password" feature enough?

It's better than nothing, but it's generally less secure and less portable than a dedicated password manager, and doesn't offer the same account health checks or cross-platform syncing.

What's two-factor authentication, and why bother setting it up?

2FA adds a second step to logging in, usually a code from an app on your phone, so that even if someone gets your password, they still can't get into your account without that second step.

Which accounts should get 2FA first?

Your email is the priority, since it's usually the key to resetting passwords on everything else. Banking, superannuation and social media accounts come next.

What happens if I forget my master password?

Most reputable password managers have a recovery process, but it depends on the account settings you choose during setup. We walk you through this clearly so you're never locked out with no way back in.

Can you set this up across all of my devices?

Yes, computer, phone and tablet, all syncing to the same secure vault.

Is training actually included, or is it just an install?

Training is included. We walk you through using it day-to-day so it actually gets used, rather than being set up once and forgotten.
